text: ML Drift's Metal InferenceContext encodes every node of the GPU graph on each run, skipping only nodes whose optional tags are disabled (no caller tags any): EncodeWithCommandQueue, which the delegate's Dispatch uses for the passive and active waits LiteRT-LM requests, and EncodeWithCommandBuffer, used for DoNotWait, both do this. So weights_convert nodes in a prefill graph run on every prefill run.
